blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department (CDRRMD) here hoisted an “extreme caution” warning on Wednesday as the heat index reached a scorching 41°C. But CDRRMD’s two-day forecast for Thursday, October 22, is that the heat index is expected to hit the “danger” warning level of 42°C. Under these sweltering conditions, the CDRRMD warned that prolonged heat exposure could trigger heat cramps and heat exhaustion, and may ultimately result in heat stroke.
